lines.text: Most business ideas never reach a first order. They stall on a logo, a website, payments. AxoriOS is a voice-first agent that takes you from idea to paid order.
Just tell it what you sell, in your own words.
From one voice note, Axori AI writes a brand kit: a name, a colour palette, fonts, and a tone of voice.
I change anything by just asking. Here I rename the shop, and price my signature cake at fifty thousand naira.
Nothing goes live until I approve it.
And there's the storefront. Designed, live, and ready for orders.

Customers can also buy right inside Telegram. Axori AI answers in their language, even Pidgin, quotes from the real catalogue, and sends a PayPal link. It can't invent prices. Totals come from the database.
The shop is priced in naira. PayPal charges dollars, at the rate shown before paying, and the order keeps both amounts.
Axori AI also writes on-brand posts with the real price drawn on, schedules them only after I approve, and syncs the catalogue to Shopify in one step.
And everything lives in one place. Sales, orders, customers, and PayPal payouts, with every number reconciled against PayPal.
AxoriOS. From idea to first paid order. Built on PayPal.
